paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Distribution of samples (%) across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of samples across different levels of ambiguity, specifically represented by sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity. The chart includes five slices: “Std: 0.0” colored in dark blue, representing approximately 47.7% of the total; “Std: 0.47” colored in light blue, accounting for approximately 7.0%; “Std: 0.82” colored in teal, representing approximately 49.0%; “Max Ambiguity (Inner)” colored in light gray, representing approximately 14.2%; and “Max: 1, 2, 3” colored in light blue, representing approximately 38.0% and 39.0% respectively. A legend is present, indicating the different ambiguity levels and their corresponding colors. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in proportion, with “Std: 0.82” taking up the largest segment.
